instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' in public/index.html or index.css.
Implement theme switcher supporting 'system', 'light', and 'dark' with persistence in localStorage and class toggle on document.documentElement.
Use exact primary accent #2cc0ff with modern minimalist solid pill for the active sidebar item.
Format all currency display and real-time inputs as Rp with dot grouping (e.g. Rp1.000.000).
Keep target goal image dimensions natural (use object-contain / object-cover with max-h-56) to ensure pictures are never awkwardly cropped.

Implement the 4 admin tabs with complete functionality: Website Settings (community name, header tagline, bottom sidebar note), Role Management (with color picker & protected APP role), Member Verification, and Yearly Member Kas Matrix.
Replace email on Member Directory cards with a WhatsApp shortcut button with phone number formatting.
Ensure all interactive items include the specified data-testid attributes for E2E testing reliability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic default Inter or Roboto for headings. Use Outfit or Plus Jakarta Sans.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use crystal glass with backdrop blur and minimum 70% opacity.
Do not apply global 'transition: all' to avoid layout jumping; specify exact transition properties (opacity, transform, background-color).

Always use the designated category color mappings in Recharts for expenses (Langganan: #3b82f6, Target: #ef4444, Event: #10b981, Lainnya: #f59e0b) and income (Kas: #2cc0ff, Support: #a855f7, Hasil Project: #06b6d4, Lainnya: #64748b).
Use Sonner for toast notifications across transactions, approvals, profile saves, and feedback actions.
